acceptance: Feedback guidance selects an exact freshly advertised native item-wait descriptor with schema-valid arguments through the existing connection, or an independently admitted authenticated host socket. Missing capability preserves supported reads and comments without invented routes, fields, credentials or authority.

Collaboration distinguishes transport admission, committed comment acknowledgment, actual same-item peer acknowledgment, design delivery, complete design read acknowledgment, implementation verification and reporter acceptance. A saved comment or item brief establishes none of the later milestones.

Synthetic request examples respect current schema and privacy boundaries. Design handoff identifies the complete intended document and revision, preserves disclosure authorization, sanitization and size limits, and reports unsupported delivery without inventing attachment or document operations.

Authorized active observation uses returned cursors within service and host limits. Gaps require current detail and necessary paging; uncertain writes require reconciliation without blind replay. Cancellation, denied authority, terminal outcomes and bounded failure recovery stop or constrain continuation appropriately.

Journey wait expiry remains distinct from transport lifetime. Re-arming uses current service-returned state and permitted actions. Active waiting establishes no idle wake, persistent monitoring or autonomous peer execution.

Canonical guidance and maintained generated consumers remain equivalent under existing transformations. Required skill versions and exact dependency pins advance consistently, package metadata remains valid, and existing connection, lifecycle and discussion runtime behavior is preserved.

Shared entrypoints preserve individual-record graph completion after clarification, complete intermediate routes, compact preferred presentation, truthful partial evidence, ranking provenance, explicit format choices, native rendering priority, plain labels and the focused student-workflow exception.
